topics.title: Introduction to programming
topics.description: What a program is, how a computer runs it, and how C++ code becomes a running program.

topics.title: Problem-solving methodology
topics.description: Understand the problem, plan the steps, then write and test the code.

topics.title: Algorithms
topics.description: Exact, ordered steps that solve a problem, written before any code.

topics.title: Pseudocode
topics.description: Writing an algorithm in structured plain words before translating it to C++.

topics.title: Variables
topics.description: Named places in memory that hold a value your program can change.

topics.title: Data types
topics.description: int, float, double, char, string and bool: what each one stores and how to choose.

topics.title: Operators
topics.description: Arithmetic, assignment and relational operators, and why % is handy for even and odd.

topics.title: Flowcharts
topics.description: Drawing an algorithm with standard shapes: ovals, parallelograms, rectangles, diamonds and arrows.

topics.title: Conditional statements
topics.description: Choosing between two paths with IF … THEN … ELSE, then with if and else in C++.

topics.title: While loops
topics.description: Repeating steps while a condition stays true, first in pseudocode and then in C++.

topics.title: Input and output
topics.description: Printing with cout and reading the user's values with cin.

topics.title: For loops
topics.description: Repeating code a known number of times with a counter.

topics.title: Do-while loops
topics.description: Loops that always run at least once, such as input validation.

topics.title: Debugging
topics.description: Finding and fixing loops that never stop, run the wrong number of times or skip their body.

topics.title: Tracing programs
topics.description: Running a program by hand with a trace table to predict its output.

topics.title: Nested conditions
topics.description: Decisions inside decisions, and when to combine conditions instead.

topics.title: Nested loops
topics.description: A loop inside a loop: rows and columns, patterns and tables.

topics.title: Arrays
topics.description: Storing many values of one type under one name, with indexes from 0.

topics.title: Functions
topics.description: Naming a block of code, passing it values and getting a result back.
